HYPOTHESIS.finding: 'Cross-field concept collisions yield computable reasoning criteria at a rate above a random-triple baseline' was never put to a controlled test: no non-Nous or random-triple input was ever forged under a fixed judge, and the only external outcome (forge status) is dominated by the forge calendar. Neither the hypothesis nor its negation ('exhaust') is supported by the record. Cleric A2/A3/A6: within regime x forge-day strata the selection score ranks forge survivors at or below chance (AUC 0.4577; 99.05% of 2000 stratified nulls above it; v1-only 0.4519), which kills the SELECTOR, not the premise about triples.

DESIGN.finding: The design cannot answer its own question: (a) the selection score is the generating model's self-rating of its own completion, with no external criterion; (b) no control arm; (c) the prompt was changed mid-series (theorist -> engineer, commit da42cc7e0) and the shipped README kept the v1-regime yield claim. (The README's per-dimension weight table is not cited: the dossier's own stratified numbers refute it, implementability AUC 0.4182 within forge day; Cleric C-7.) Load-bearing: the '20-30% warrant forging' and 'high-potential' framing that later dossiers inherited comes from (a)+(c); measured high_potential is 41.8% (v1) and 0.84% (v2), so the 20-30% figure is unsourced.

IMPLEMENTATION.finding: The code does what the design says: scorer replay reproduces 5918/5918 stored scores from stored text; rating parse failures are 1.5% overall and concentrated in the 800-max_tokens run (79/87), fixed by max_tokens 2048 and rescore.py; the Coeus-weight loader, cross-field sampler, checkpointing and priority-triple injection are exercised paths (priority triples appear in the forge ledger on 03-31).

MEASUREMENT.finding: The measurement carries its answer: the composite is the LLM's self-rating; its apparent forge signal (pooled AUC 0.755) is the forge calendar crossed with the prompt switch. Within forge day the AUC is 0.5194 (deterministic 2000-permutation null: 2.5%..97.5% = 0.4647..0.533, frac_null_ge_obs 0.138; the Necromancer's original null was hash-order nondeterministic, Cleric C-1). Within regime x forge-day strata it is 0.4577 with 99.05% of nulls ABOVE it (v1-only 0.4519, 98.9%): inside any fixed judge state the score ranks forgeable triples at or below chance. The per-regime unstratified AUCs (v1 0.5757, v2 0.6527) are a calendar confound: mean composite and forge rate fall together by day (v1: 03-25 7.535/0.583, 03-26 7.283/0.263, 03-27 7.118/0.196) and v1 sits at ceiling (222/223 entries on 03-25 with composite >= 7). The score distribution moved from 41.8% to 0.84% high_potential when the prompt changed with the model fixed: the score measures the prompt. Load-bearing: every downstream reading of Nous 'quality' (README yield claim, Coeus weights, forge priority) rests on this score.

INTERPRETATION.finding: Later readers turned an input dependency and a launch pairing into a 'zombie gate', a lower-bound date into 'stopped', an unread generator into 'exhaust', and a superseded lineage into a stall; the README turned a v1-prompt yield into a standing claim; the 2026-06 dossiers state that the code was not read. Provenance: no autopsy row, no run log, uncommitted output, README/model/field mismatches. Added after the Cleric: the README's '20-30% warrant forging' and '397B model' claims are unsourced (measured 41.8%/0.84% and nemotron 5915/5918); 'M4' is a 2026-05-13 forward assignment read back as run history by the ROSTER and by this dossier's first draft.

ECOSYSTEM.finding: Nous had exactly one coded consumer (the Hephaestus forge) and one feedback producer (Coeus). The consumer's API instrument degraded 2026-03-28..04-02 (athena_forge_status_20260329.md: 0/98 forged, 'NVIDIA API appears to still be degraded'; STATUS_T1_T2_20260403.md: '20 attempts, all scrap'; 739 of the 1212 orphan ledger rows api_call_failed), the operator re-routed forging to Claude Code (commit c181461cd 'bypass NVIDIA API'; 97.8% coverage without the API forge), and the pipeline idled at 2026-04-02 12:43. nous_t2 is an ADDED T2 tier over tool combinations (journal_20260402.md: 'lower tiers never stop', 'let T1 keep running 24/7'), not a successor; no commit or journal in 03-24..04-04 records a decision to shelve Nous, and every repair in that window is forge-side. The layer is INVALID because the seam failed Nous (its output was API-forged at 0-8% and then not forged at all), but the charter's single ECOSYSTEM class ('nothing useful consumed what it emitted') does not describe it: 95.1% of committed output was attempted and 385 keys forged. Consumer-instrument failure plus operator attention re-allocation has no class (DEFECTS). Load-bearing for the recorded 'shelved/LIMBO' status; not the primary cause of the missing fair test.

fair_test.scope: All committed runs (2026-03-24..03-28) and the forge windows that consumed them (03-24..04-02, 05-16..05-28).
fair_test.finding: The capability 'select concept triples that yield computable reasoning criteria' was never fairly exercised: the selection score is a self-rating with no external criterion (MEASUREMENT, load-bearing), there is no control arm and the prompt changed mid-series with the claim frozen at v1 (DESIGN, load-bearing). The forge outcome cannot serve as the criterion because it is instrument-dominated (58% -> 2.5% by day) and the stratified test is null. A fair test needs a frozen forge judge, api-state excluded, and a random-triple or non-Nous arm.

disposition.rationale: Chosen over MEASUREMENT_FAILURE because the measurement defect is downstream of a design that had no external criterion and no control arm: even a perfect forge judge could not have said whether Nous's triples beat random ones, since no non-Nous arm was ever run. Chosen over ORCHESTRATION_FAILURE / PRODUCER_BLOCKED / CONSUMER_BLOCKED because the pipeline moved: 95.1% of output was consumed and the forge ran 1212 more keys than the tree records. Chosen over SUPERSEDED_BUT_ORGANS_SALVAGEABLE because nous_t2 was an added tier, not a replacement (Cleric C-4); the earlier sentence 'supersession explains why it stopped' is struck. Not TRUE_CORPSE: the hypothesis was never tested. Not optimistic: within every fixed judge state the selector ranks at or below chance (Cleric C-2), so the record shows Nous doing nothing a dictionary sampler would not have done; what it does not show is anything about the triple premise itself.
